configuration: keepout inflation + progress 0.1 m/10 s + rotation shim with 1.5 s DWB horizon + probabilistic AMCL + SmacPlanner2D without smoothing
method: Fortress physics and laser. Source robot Nav2 parameters; only sim time, sensor topic, known initial pose, file paths and standalone bond settings adapted. No hardware connections.
pose_error_method: AMCL header timestamp matched to interpolated world-pose odometry; wrapped heading; outside-range estimates excluded and reported.
footprint_check: 0.277 x 0.212 m rectangle plus 0.01 m padding, intersected with fixture geometry at odometry samples; not a 3D contact-sensor guarantee.
patrol_scope: Two mapped rooms, NORMAL /patrol, RGB-D/lidar observations, default 120 s external analysis timeout and return. AI analysis/reobservation not connected.
